rationale: Verified on disk before judging: the plan file at the reviewed head 97becd3 is byte-identical to the working tree (raw sha 6bb8cf01...), the cited plan_ref bb2ea18f... is the recorded canonicalized-candidate address pinned by run-product-authorization.mjs and authorization-summary.json, and both cited evidence artifacts (the advisory Gemini referee adjudication and the Eye spikes-nonblocking directive) exist at their stated paths. On the plan's own terms it is implementation-ready. ENFORCEMENT: E1-E6 are genuinely fail-closed with adversarial regressions that reproduce each defect — E1's substrate-separated publisher with controller-owned refs, credentialless proposed-bytes CI jobs, merge-commit-precedence evidence resolution, producer-authenticated checks, mandatory Eye pre-merge acceptance, and the serialized attest-eligible-reenumerate-GO ceremony with the (3)->(4) window recorded as an explicit trust-root non-claim rather than a false atomicity claim; E2's base-anchored verifier closure with out-of-tree chain roots, the covered_files-binding transition signature (the run-1 ratified hard stop, correctly folded), executable-edge closure enumeration for verdict producers, and an honest two-tier clean-room criterion where TIER 1's anchor-unavailable DENIAL is the pass; E3's structurally exceptionless auditor; E4's default flip with the contradiction blocker; E5's reconcile-and-supersede per the recorded Eye ruling; E6's two-sided discrimination (mutation negatives plus conforming-variant positives), closed mutation registry with domain-cardinality bounds, same-path baseline-controlled execution, and the pure-evaluator ABI making determinism structural rather than asserted. No mutable label keys any enforcement decision; every identity is content-addressed; custody claims are made deterministically verifiable across all writer classes rather than asserted. GOVERNANCE: the four-step bootstrap transaction under sitting v15 authority is lawful (the change_rule being regularized is exactly the successor path now followed), AM-42 bytes are untouched with linkage confined to registry rows, AM-43's two-phase authorize-then-activate lifecycle correctly avoids breaking the exact-bijection inventory gates at the bootstrap head, and the non-woven staging of AM-43 honestly refuses to trust the known-nondiscriminating pre-fix weave verifier. PRODUCT: the Phase-0 gate has no report-only escape and the checklist bijection closes the omitted-item hole; the Phase-1a install contract is honest (source release, dual-mode doctor with self-consistent-vs-authenticated labeling, operator-supplied out-of-band trust roots, mandatory pre-execution external verification, bundle-tree binding); the Chromium-only qualified envelope bounds claims without deferring the frozen deploy blocker. ATOMIC WEAVE: the content-addressed closure + input-history digests resolve the run-2 self-reference paradox soundly, and the union-over-both-trees input discovery closes both the added-file and deleted-file blind spots in the CI mode split. CARRIED-FORWARD RATIFICATIONS (explicit, per the objective): (i) I RATIFY the §6b Accepted Argo Spikes register including SPIKE-E6-EVALUATOR-FORM — deferring the concrete declarative-oracle grammar to a pre-implementation merge-gate on the oracle-hardening slice is acceptable because the soundness question is settled in-plan (a declarative surface in which lookup-table oracles are structurally inexpressible), only the concrete form is open, and the interim is fail-closed (mandatory adversarial source review of every normative oracle record as an authority change, plus the determinized battery), so the lookup-table attack is closed at every stage rather than left green; the register itself honestly disclaims self-authorization and reserves disposition to this council and the S3 grant, which is exactly right. (ii) I RATIFY the pre-review open_questions_for_the_eye including product-1-oq-e6-determinism-deferral on the same basis — the advisory referee record is treated as advisory and the deferral decision is the Eye's, consistent with the non-delegable human-authority invariant. A bounded, honestly-recorded implementation spike with a fail-closed interim is not a contradiction, and I find no remaining plan contradiction, unsound design, or conflict with the recorded Eye rulings, the governing pre-review, or the repository trust model. Residuals are correctly recorded as non-claims (single-trust-principal Eye root, ceremony-window App capabilities, Phase-1b register items) rather than papered over. Approved as-is.
